**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Cap structure (acceptable):** §§ 9.1/9.2 are genuinely mutual and both run to the greater of $100,000 or twelve months' charges preceding accrual of the first claim; indemnification payments sit outside the cap as a separate limb; § 10 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually. Those fallback elements are already met.
- **Failure:** no carve-out for confidentiality breach, gross negligence or willful misconduct anywhere in the document — and § 6 expressly makes Sections 5, 9 and 10 prevail over the confidentiality agreement, so confidentiality claims are capped.
- **Cure:** one inserted sentence (new § 9.3) lifting the Section 9 limits for those three categories, for both parties — no rewrite of the existing caps.
- **Noted in rationale only (preferred-level, not redlined):** $100,000 floor vs USD 1,000,000, no fraud/IP-infringement carve-outs, payment obligations not excluded from capped damages, and the § 9.1(c)(2) records/data exclusion.
